docs.t: When is my tax return due?
docs.q: When is my tax return due?
docs.a: In general, with a 31 March balance date: income tax returns are due 7 July, or 31 March the following year if you're with a tax agent; terminal tax is due 7 February (7 April with a tax agent's extension); standard provisional tax is due 28 August, 15 January and 7 May; GST is due on the 28th of the month after the period ends, except periods ending November (15 January) and March (7 May). Your own dates may differ, and we'll confirm them.

docs.t: Tax, explained in your language.: Four areas of work
docs.a: Each one is handled in-house by the same team. Scroll and the book turns to the next one. Taxation & Accounting Compliance. Tax compliance and practical consulting services, for individuals, rental property owners and businesses on Xero or MYOB. Whatever the tax position, talk to us. GST, IR3 and IR4 returns and end-of-year financial statements. IRD audits, compliance reviews and negotiating tax debt. Tax pooling through TMNZ, so you pay provisional tax when it suits you. Trusts, company formation, PAYE and payroll as add-ons. Read more on our site. Business Advisory & Planning. Create a profitable, thriving and valuable business. Business planning begins with a free first meeting: a one-on-one workshop on your business and personal goals for the next 3 months, 12 months and 3 years. Business planning, first meeting free of charge. Cashflow forecasting. Monthly coaching, so you know where you are heading and what the goals are. Read more on our site. Employment & HR Advisory. Your employment law and HR partner. The most valuable asset in your business is your staff. Employment relations and policies. Employer accreditation, and restructure and redundancy. Personal grievances and disputes. Audit and investigations, including Labour Inspector readiness. Read more on our site. Property Investment & Development. Practical advice on optimal structuring of your property investments and developments to keep up with the ever-changing property taxation laws and regulations. Structuring: personal ownership, a look-through company or a trust. Strategy for buy and hold, trading and flips, development and land banking. Returns, financial statements and cash-flow tools. Family trust management and advisory. Read more on our site.

docs.t: Tax, explained in your language.: Good to know first
docs.a: Short answers. For anything specific to you, book a chat. What happens when I first get in touch? We will ask a few questions about your situation, such as your income, any property, a business or a trust, and arrange a time to talk it through. The first consultation is free, on all matters. Can I come to the office? Yes, at 620 Manukau Road in Epsom, Monday to Friday 9:30am to 5:30pm or Saturday 11:30am to 3:00pm, with free on-site parking. Please call first so we can set a time. I owe Inland Revenue money. Can you help? Yes. We help with compliance reviews and IRD audits, negotiate arrears for GST, PAYE and income tax, and respond to letters of demand. Whatever the tax position, talk to us. Can you look after a family trust or a rental property? Yes. Family trust management and advisory is one of our services, with staff trained in trust and estate management, and property structuring is a specialty: personal ownership, a look-through company or a trust. What is tax pooling? Tax pooling through Tax Management NZ (TMNZ) lets you pay provisional tax when it suits you. Whether it suits your situation is something we will go through with you.
